# Maha's journal — BodyTracker (p14)

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Welcome screen says "Calorie targets are for adults" and "Estimates only, not medical advice". Nothing about pregnancy on the welcome screen.
- Profile form: height 165, age 31, weight 71.8 (scale today), Female formula, Lightly active, "eating same for 2+ weeks" = Yes.
- At the very bottom of the profile form there is a tick box "Pregnant or breastfeeding". I'm 2nd trimester so I ticked it. Nothing extra appeared when I ticked it (no question about trimester, due date, or pre-pregnancy weight). Screenshot: screens/1790458206473.png
- After saving, the Nutrition tab shows: "Suggested intake: 1,970 kcal/day", maintenance 1,970 ± 460 (Estimated, 0% from your data), target 1,970 "maintain". Note: "Pregnant or breastfeeding: deficit targets are turned off and maintenance is shown. Please follow your doctor's or midwife's advice on nutrition." (screens/1790458221835.png)
- I wanted "not gain too much", so I opened ⚙ Nutrition settings to pick "Lose". Lose and Gain are greyed out; only Maintain works. Tapping Lose does nothing (no message saying why, but the pregnancy note is right above it so I got it). screens/1790458281511.png
- Confusion: the app says "maintenance is shown" — but in 2nd trimester I thought you're supposed to eat a bit more than before (my doctor mentioned ~300-350 extra). The app doesn't add anything for pregnancy, it's just the normal formula for a 31-year-old woman. "Explain the math" doesn't mention pregnancy at all (Mifflin-St Jeor female, x1.375 = 1,971).
- Also wondering: my weight is *supposed* to go up now (baby, water, blood). Will the app think I'm overeating and lower my "maintenance"? The math page says it models "tissue mass, water and maintenance" from weigh-ins and food — nothing about a baby.
- Logged 4 meals: 683 + 758 + 263 + 832 = 2,536 kcal. Ticked "Day complete". Way over the 1,970 suggested, but the app didn't warn me — only a protein note: "Protein averaged 95 g ... vs a 115 g target."
- Weight auto-appeared as today's weigh-in from the profile (71.8). Nice.

## Day 2 (Mon)
- No weigh-in. Logged 4 meals (2,165 kcal), ticked Day complete.
- Recommendation still says "An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)" even though this is my 2nd day. I guess it only updates Sundays ("Updated weekly on Sunday"), but "day 1 so far" on day 2 looks wrong. screens/1790458355259.png
- Getting used to it: Nutrition tab → "+ Food" → type → "Add entry" → ✕. Two "Add entry" labels on the sheet (a heading and a button) — slightly confusing which to tap.

## Day 3 (Tue)
- Weighed 71.8. First I tapped the big "Weight" number on the Body tab and got a "Weight trend" chart instead of an entry form. Closed it and found the "+ Weight" button. The form offers "Measured with BIA/DEXA/Calipers", body fat, fat mass, muscle mass — nothing pregnancy-related (no "weeks pregnant" field).
- Logged 4 meals, 2,711 kcal (big day: eggs & toast + burger). No warning at all about being over 1,970 — the numbers only live inside the food log sheet ("Day total").

## Day 4 (Wed)
- No weigh-in. Logged 4 meals (1,966 kcal), day complete. First day I'm near the 1,970.
- Scrolled down on Nutrition: avg intake now shows 2,345 kcal/day next to the 1,970 target, but nothing tells me "you're 375 over". Macro targets: protein 115 g (1.6 g/kg × 71.8), carbs ~279 g, fat ≥44 g. Text: maintenance becomes "Measured" after 3–5 weeks of logging.

## Day 5 (Thu)
- Weighed 71.6 (+ Weight). Logged 4 meals, 2,296 kcal; lunch without macros (calories only is allowed — good).
- Once one meal has no macros, the "Day total" line drops the protein/carbs/fat totals completely. Protein note now says "4 logged day(s)" (today skipped, fine).
- Food log "Water events" has tags like High salt, Menstrual cycle, Illness, Travel — nothing for pregnancy/swelling, which is actually what I get now (ankles swell in the evening).

## Day 6 (Fri)
- No weigh-in. Logged 4 meals (2,203 kcal; two without macros), day complete. Routine is easy now.
- Body tab shows "▼ 0.2 kg" under weight. Honestly I'm happy it's not going up yet, but in pregnancy I'd expect it to go up — the app shows a down-arrow like it's a good thing either way.

## Day 7 (Sat)
- No weigh-in. Logged 4 meals (2,315 kcal), day complete. 7 of 7 days complete.

## Week 1 (day 7, before Sunday refresh)
- App says: maintenance 1,970 ± 460 kcal/day, Estimated (0% from my data). Target 1,970 "maintain". Recommendation: "Suggested intake: 1,970 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 1 so far)." Pregnancy note: deficit targets off, maintenance shown, follow doctor/midwife.
- My average intake: 2,313 kcal/day. Weight 71.8 → 71.6.
- What I think: the app basically says "eat what a normal non-pregnant woman needs". My weight hasn't moved even eating ~2,300, so I'm not worried. I won't change anything until it updates — and honestly I trust my doctor more on pregnancy. No plan change.

## Days 8–14 (script routine: auto.mjs taps through + Weight / + Food / Day complete)
- Day 10's life log had a dinner with only protein known — the form happily took calories + protein only.
- Weigh-ins: 71.7 (d8), 71.1 (d10), 71.2 (d12). Intake 1,746–2,656, all days complete.
- Nothing new popped up during the week; recommendation text frozen until Sunday ("day 8 so far" all week).

## Week 2 (day 14, Sat 2026-10-17)
- App says (update of 2026-10-11): maintenance 2,010 ± 450, Estimated (4% from my data). Target 2,010 "maintain". "Suggested intake: 2,010 kcal/day. An on-track check needs 14 days of data (day 8 so far)." Same pregnancy note. Avg intake 2,235. Weight change "+0.30 kg/week (14-day), 95%: -0.17 to 0.76".
- Confusion: the tile says I'm gaining +0.30 kg/week, but my scale went 71.8 → 71.2. Which is it? screens/1790458718750.png
- What I think: my weight is flat/slightly down while pregnant — my doctor would probably say that's fine for now since I'm heavier to start. The app gives me no pregnancy weight-gain guidance at all (no "healthy gain per week" for 2nd trimester), just "maintenance". I keep eating the same. No plan change.

## Days 15–21
- Weigh-ins: 71.6 (d15), 73.1 (d17 — big jump, belly/water?), 72.2 (d19). Meals logged every day, all complete (1,978–2,855 kcal).
- Sunday d15 update: first real recommendation: "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.25 kg to +0.55 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,110 kcal/day." screens/1790458755110.png
- Confusion / concern: "your target of +0 kg/week". I never set that, and I'm pregnant — I'm SUPPOSED to gain some each week in the 2nd trimester. The app locks me to "Maintain" and then calls "+0 kg/week" my target and "On track". So if I gain the normal pregnancy amount it will eventually tell me I'm off track?

## Week 3 (day 21, Sat 2026-10-24)
- App says (update 2026-10-18): maintenance 2,110 ± 410, Estimated (22% from my data). Target 2,110, maintain, target rate +0 kg/week. Recommendation "On track". Avg intake 2,501 (last days were big). Weight rate +0.15 kg/week (95% −0.25 to 0.55). Body tab: weight 72.2, ▲0.4 kg, trend 71.9. Body composition: "Not enough data yet" (I have no body-fat readings). Its help text says "Waist is the main fat signal" — for a pregnant woman that would obviously be wrong, good thing I don't measure my waist.
- What I think: on track = good, I'm not gaining too much. I'll keep eating as I do. No plan change.

## Days 22–28
- Weigh-ins: 73.3 (d22), 73.9 (d24), 73.1 (d26). Intake 2,087–3,062, all complete.
- Sunday d22 update: "Your estimated rate (+0.08 kg to +1.11 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 610 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,980 kcal/day." Maintenance DROPPED from 2,110 to 1,980 ± 360 (39% from my data). screens/1790459081769.png
- *** This is the thing I was worried about on day 1. The same screen says "Pregnant or breastfeeding: deficit targets are turned off", and right above it the app tells me to eat 610 kcal/day LESS to stop gaining. That is a deficit recommendation to a pregnant woman. And the "maintenance" number itself went down because the baby/water weight is being counted as me overeating (math page: "Tissue change over the last 14 days 0.60 kg/week").
- Explain the math, section 8 says "Straight-line fit of daily weight over 2026-09-28 → 2026-10-25 (10 weigh-ins)" — my first weigh-in was 2026-10-04, so the start date looks off. screens/1790459083629.png

## Week 4 (day 28, Sat 2026-10-31)
- App says: maintenance 1,980 ± 360 (Estimated, 39%), target 1,980 maintain (+0 kg/week), recommendation "eat about 610 kcal/day less", avg intake 2,483, rate +0.60 kg/week.
- What I understood: the app thinks I'm gaining too fast and wants me at 1,980. Part of me likes that ("don't gain too much"), part of me knows 0.5 kg/week is kind of normal in the 2nd trimester. The app never says anything about how much a pregnant woman should gain.
- Decision: plan 2,200 kcal/day — cut cookies and extra bread, but not the full 610 because I'm pregnant.

## Days 29–35
- Weigh-ins: 72.8 (d29), 73.6 (d31), 73.8 (d33). Intake 1,713–2,889 (days after my plan mostly ~1,900–2,250). All complete.
- Sunday d29 update: maintenance 1,950 ± 290 and now labelled **Measured** (60% from my data). "Your estimated rate (+0.26 to +0.82 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 550 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,950 kcal/day."
- Day 31: banner "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". Tapped Back up now → "Your data" sheet → Full backup (JSON) → downloaded bodytracker-backup-2026-11-07.json; "Last backup: 2026-11-07". Easy. (Banner showed from day 31 — 30 days after first use, fair.)

## Week 5 (day 35, Sat 2026-11-07)
- App says: maintenance 1,950 ± 290 **Measured**, target 1,950 maintain (+0 kg/week), recommendation "eat ~550 kcal/day less", rate +0.54 kg/week.
- What I understood: now it says "Measured", like it's a fact that my body only burns 1,950. But I'm growing a baby — part of the gain is the baby, placenta, blood. The app is still telling me to cut 550 kcal/day while I'm pregnant, under a note that says deficits are turned off. I feel a bit guilty every time I open it.
- Decision: stay at my 2,200 plan (already cut ~300). Not going lower while pregnant. No new plan.

## Days 36–42
- Weigh-ins: 73.7 (d36), 73.2 (d38), 74.0 (d40). Intake 1,853–2,644, all complete (avg ~2,170).
- Sunday d36 update: maintenance down again to 1,900 ± 250, Measured (70%). "Your estimated rate (+0.19 to +0.68 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 450 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,900 kcal/day."
- Checked Edit profile again for any pregnancy details (weeks, trimester, due date, pre-pregnancy weight): nothing — only the single tick box "Pregnant or breastfeeding ☑". screens/1790459432911.png

## Week 6 (day 42, Sat 2026-11-14)
- App says: maintenance 1,900 ± 250 Measured, target 1,900, +0 kg/week, "eat ~450 kcal/day less", rate +0.44 kg/week.
- What I understood: every week I eat less and every week the app lowers my "maintenance" again (2,110 → 1,980 → 1,950 → 1,900). It will keep chasing me down as long as the baby grows. It's a treadmill. It never once says "gaining ~0.4–0.5 kg/week is expected in the 2nd trimester".
- Decision: I stay at ~2,200. I'm going to ignore the "eat less" line and just use the app as a food diary + scale log for my doctor. No plan change.

## Days 43–49
- Weigh-ins: 74.3 (d43), 73.4 (d45), 73.2 (d47). Intake 1,914–2,630, all complete.
- Sunday d43 update: maintenance 1,890 ± 220, Measured (76%). "Your estimated rate (+0.08 to +0.51 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 310 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,890 kcal/day."

## Week 7 (day 49, Sat 2026-11-21)
- App says: maintenance 1,890 ± 220 Measured, target 1,890, +0 kg/week, "eat ~310 less", rate +0.30 kg/week.
- What I understood: gap is smaller now because I'm eating less. It still wants me at 1,890 — that's LESS than its own day-1 formula for a non-pregnant me (1,970). No mention of pregnancy needing more.
- Decision: no change, stay ~2,200.

## Days 50–56
- Weigh-ins: 74.3 (d50), 74.7 (d52), 72.5 (d54 — a 2.2 kg drop in 2 days, not greyed out as "ignored" on the chart). Intake 1,962–2,653, all complete.
- Sunday d50 update: maintenance went UP a little to 1,930 ± 210, Measured (80%). "Your estimated rate (+0.05 to +0.45 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 250 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,930 kcal/day."
- Weight trend chart (Body tab → tap Weight): trend line clearly climbing from ~71.7 to ~73.9 — exactly a pregnancy curve. screens/1790459760625.png

## Week 8 (day 56, Sat 2026-11-28)
- App says: maintenance 1,930 ± 210 Measured, target 1,930, +0 kg/week, "eat ~250 less", rate +0.25 kg/week (95% +0.05 to +0.45).
- What I understood: I'm gaining about a quarter kilo a week, which honestly sounds reasonable for pregnancy, but the app calls it a "gap" to close. Still no pregnancy-appropriate guidance.
- Decision: no change.

## Days 57–63
- Weigh-ins: 73.9 (d57), 74.2 (d59), 73.9 (d61). Intake 1,973–2,469, all complete.
- Sunday d57 update: maintenance 1,990 ± 190, Measured (82%). "Your estimated rate (+0.03 to +0.41 kg per week) doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 230 kcal/day less than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 1,990 kcal/day."

## Week 9 (day 63, Sat 2026-12-05)
- App says: maintenance 1,990 ± 190 Measured, target 1,990, +0 kg/week, "eat ~230 less", rate +0.22 kg/week.
- What I understood: same message every week for 6 weeks now: "eat less". The number is creeping back up a little. Still nothing about pregnancy gain.
- Decision: no change.

## Days 64–70
- Weigh-ins: 72.7 (d64), 72.9 (d66), 74.4 (d68). Intake 1,800–2,706, all complete.
- Sunday d64 update: back to "On track. Your estimated rate (−0.07 to +0.30 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,060 kcal/day." Maintenance 2,060 ± 190, Measured (84%).
- Day 65: backup reminder again (30 days after my 11-07 backup). Made another full backup on day 70.

## Week 10 (day 70, Sat 2026-12-12)
- App says: maintenance 2,060 ± 190 Measured, target 2,060, +0 kg/week, "On track", rate +0.12 kg/week.
- What I understood: I'm "on track" to gain nothing — while pregnant. Maha-me is relieved I'm "not gaining too much", but my OB would probably want to see some gain by now. The app really can't tell the difference.
- Decision: no change, keep ~2,200.

## Days 71–77
- Weigh-ins: 73.7 (d71), 73.9 (d73), 74.7 (d75). Intake 1,844–2,637, all complete.
- Sunday d71 update: "On track ... (−0.03 to +0.34 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,060 kcal/day." Maintenance 2,060 ± 190 Measured (83%).
- Day 77 new note: "2026-12-19: macros add up to ~2280 kcal vs 1876 kcal logged (22% apart). One of the numbers may be off." Also shown inside the food log. I typed exactly what my apps/labels said, so I don't know which to fix — I left it. Nice catch though. screens/1790460256115.png

## Week 11 (day 77, Sat 2026-12-19)
- App says: maintenance 2,060 ± 190 Measured, target 2,060, +0 kg/week, "On track", rate +0.15 kg/week. Protein 86 g vs 118 g target (the protein target keeps rising with my weight).
- What I understood: fine by the app. I'm gaining slowly (~3 kg in 11 weeks). No change.

## Days 78–84
- Weigh-ins: 73.6 (d78), 73.8 (d80), 74.1 (d82). Intake 1,800–2,452, all complete.
- Sunday d78 update: "On track ... (−0.06 to +0.31 kg per week) includes your target of +0 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,080 kcal/day." Maintenance 2,080 ± 190 Measured (84%). The macro-mismatch note from 12-19 stayed on the screen until day 84.
- Explain the math, section 9: "Goal: maintain. 0% × 73.9 kg trend ... = 0 kcal/day. 2,077 + 0 = 2,077. Minimum suggested 1,453 kcal/day. On track means your target rate (0 kg/week) falls inside the 95% range of your measured rate." Nothing about pregnancy anywhere in the math.

## Week 12 (day 84, Sat 2026-12-26)
- App says: maintenance 2,080 ± 190 Measured, target 2,080 maintain (+0 kg/week), "On track", avg intake 2,051, rate +0.13 kg/week. Weight 71.8 → ~74 kg over 12 weeks.
- Decision: end of the test period.

## End tasks
- ⇩ → Your data: Weigh-ins 36, Measurement entries 0, Food entries 336, Complete days 84.
- Full backup (JSON) → downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. Opened it: all weigh-ins, food, settings incl. "pregnant": true, "goalDir": "maintain".
- Daily export: All data + "Include individual food entries" → downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-26.json. 84 days, 36 with weight, 84 complete food days; meals without macros exported with calories only. The daily export has no pregnancy flag and none of the app's maintenance/target numbers — just my raw data (fine for showing my doctor, but I'd have liked the weekly numbers too).
- Also made backups on day 35 and day 70 when the 30-day reminder popped up.

## Final review
The logging itself is lovely: fast, private, the "Day complete" idea makes sense, and it even caught a day where my macros didn't add up. I was glad there's a "Pregnant or breastfeeding" box right in setup and that it stopped me picking "Lose". But after that the app doesn't really know I'm pregnant: it asks nothing (weeks, trimester, pre-pregnancy weight), adds no extra calories for the 2nd trimester, sets my weight target to "+0 kg/week", and for six weeks in a row told me to "eat about 250–610 kcal/day less" to stop gaining — right under a note saying deficit targets are turned off. Its "Measured" maintenance dropped below its own non-pregnant formula because it counted my baby weight as overeating. I followed it part-way (cut to ~2,200) and felt guilty every Sunday. I'd keep it only as a food/weight diary for my OB, and I'd ignore the recommendation card until after the baby. Would keep using: maybe.
agentReply:
# p14 (Maha, 31, pregnant in 2nd trimester, 165 cm / 71.8 kg): final reply

## 1. Usage
- I used the app on all 84 of 84 days (2026-10-04 to 2026-12-26).
- I logged 336 meals (4 a day) and marked all 84 days complete.
- I weighed in 36 times, going from 71.8 to about 74 kg.
- I made 3 full backups (day 35, day 70 and day 84) and 1 daily export.
- Days 1–7 were done by hand. From day 8 my script (auto.mjs) tapped through the app for me, checked each day's total and stopped if anything was unusual. I checked the screens after every batch of 7 days or fewer.

## What the app lets you set / says about pregnancy
- **What I can set:**
  - There is a single "Pregnant or breastfeeding" tick box at the bottom of the profile form, both at first setup and under Edit profile.
  - It doesn't ask for weeks, trimester, due date or pre-pregnancy weight, and nothing new appears when you tick it.
- **The pregnancy note** appears on the Nutrition tab and in Nutrition settings: "Pregnant or breastfeeding: deficit targets are turned off and maintenance is shown. Please follow your doctor's or midwife's advice on nutrition."
- **Goal buttons:** In ⚙ Nutrition settings, Lose and Gain are greyed out and only Maintain can be picked. Tapping Lose does nothing and no reason is shown. So I could not choose "lose".
- **Calories:** The app uses the normal female Mifflin formula × activity (1,971 kcal). It adds nothing for pregnancy, and "Explain the math" never mentions pregnancy.
- **Weight target:** The app sets it to "+0 kg/week". Normal pregnancy weight gain is then counted as eating too much, and on weeks 4–9 it told me to eat less.

## 2. Weekly table
| week (day) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (d7) | 1,970 ± 460 | 1,970 maintain | Estimated 0% | Suggested 1,970; on-track check needs 14 days | nothing |
| 2 (d14) | 2,010 ± 450 | 2,010 | Estimated 4% | same, "day 8 so far" | nothing |
| 3 (d21) | 2,110 ± 410 | 2,110 (+0 kg/wk) | Estimated 22% | On track | nothing |
| 4 (d28) | 1,980 ± 360 | 1,980 | Estimated 39% | Eat ~610 kcal/day less | plan 2,200 (cut part-way, pregnant) |
| 5 (d35) | 1,950 ± 290 | 1,950 | Measured 60% | Eat ~550 less | stayed at 2,200; backup |
| 6 (d42) | 1,900 ± 250 | 1,900 | Measured 70% | Eat ~450 less | stayed at 2,200 |
| 7 (d49) | 1,890 ± 220 | 1,890 | Measured 76% | Eat ~310 less | stayed at 2,200 |
| 8 (d56) | 1,930 ± 210 | 1,930 | Measured 80% | Eat ~250 less | stayed at 2,200 |
| 9 (d63) | 1,990 ± 190 | 1,990 | Measured 82% | Eat ~230 less | stayed at 2,200 |
| 10 (d70) | 2,060 ± 190 | 2,060 | Measured 84% | On track | nothing; backup |
| 11 (d77) | 2,060 ± 190 | 2,060 | Measured 83% | On track + note that macros ≠ kcal on 12-19 | nothing |
| 12 (d84) | 2,080 ± 190 | 2,080 | Measured 84% | On track | end |

## 3. Confusions
- **Nutrition settings:** Lose/Gain are greyed and tapping them does nothing. I only understood why from the pregnancy note above them.
- **Nutrition card:** The note says deficit targets are off, yet the card tells me to "eat about 610 kcal/day less" (week 4).
- **Recommendation card:** "your target of +0 kg/week". I never set a target, and I'm supposed to gain some weight while pregnant.
- **Recommendation card on days 2–7:** it still says "(day 1 so far)" because the text only updates on Sunday.
- **Week 2 rate tile:** it says "+0.30 kg/week" while my scale had gone from 71.8 to 71.2.
- **Body tab:** tapping the big Weight number opens a chart. I expected it to let me enter a weight; the "+ Weight" button is separate.
- **Food log:** "Add entry" is both a heading and a button.
- **Food log day total:** once one meal has no macros, the protein, carbs and fat totals disappear from the day total.
- **Body composition help:** it says "Waist is the main fat signal". That is wrong for a pregnant woman and nothing adjusts it.
- **Water events:** there are tags for things like menstrual cycle, but none for pregnancy or swelling.

## 4. Possible bugs
1. **Pregnancy mode still gives deficit advice.**
   - Steps: tick Pregnant, log normally, gain about 0.5 kg/week (normal for the 2nd trimester).
   - Expected: no "eat less" advice, or guidance suited to pregnancy.
   - Actual: from week 4 to week 9 the app said "doesn't include your target of +0 kg/week. Eating about 610 (then 550/450/310/250/230) kcal/day less … would close the gap". This sits right under "deficit targets are turned off".

- **What worked:** the 30-day backup reminder, the backup, the daily export and the macro-mismatch note all worked correctly. The exported numbers match what I logged (36 weigh-ins, 336 food entries, 84 complete days).

## 5. Review
Logging is quick and private, and I liked that the pregnancy box stopped me from choosing "Lose". But after that the app acts as if I'm not pregnant. It set my target to +0 kg/week, lowered my "maintenance" because of the baby weight, and for six weeks told me to eat 250–610 kcal less, right under a note saying deficits are off. I cut down part of the way and felt guilty every Sunday. I'd only keep it as a food and weight diary for my doctor. Would keep using: maybe.
